resources.string: MBAudioProperty parameters via mbCAN (Android 9). Values refresh automatically. Hints are from stock apps (SystemSettings, Multimedia) and Adayo firmware (AdayoAudioConfig.json).
Tags: confirmed in stock apps · inferred from SDK/firmware · not found in stock apps
Active audio source (MBAudioSource). Range: 0=none, 1=media, 2=radio, 3=hands-free, 4=B-call, 5=voice. No explicit stock UI usage found.
Main media volume. Confirmed: 0–39 (AdayoAudioConfig MaxVolumeList, VHAL AUDIO_CURRENT_MAIN_VOLUME). 0 = mute. Used in Multimedia / SystemSettings.
Left/right balance. Confirmed: 0–49 (SoundFadeBalanceArr in firmware). Center is usually mid-range. VHAL: AUDIO_BALANCE_L/R.
Bass band gain. Firmware uses 10-band EQ; bass is band index 2 (EQFrequency). Neutral preset value: 14, typical preset range 9–21. VHAL: AUDIO_BASS_SET.
Mid band gain. Band index 5 in EQFrequency. Neutral value: 14. VHAL: AUDIO_MIDRANGE_SET.
Treble band gain. Band index 8 in EQFrequency. Neutral value: 14. VHAL: AUDIO_HIGH_PITCH.
Software mute flag. Not found in stock apps; likely 0/1.
Amplifier mute. Not found in stock apps; likely 0/1.
EQ preset index. Confirmed: 10 modes (0–9), default 7 = neutral (InitEQMode in AdayoAudioConfig). Used in Multimedia (eAUDIO_PROPERTY_EQMODE). VHAL: AUDIO_EQ_MODEL_SET.
Parking radar / APS alert volume. No MBAudioProperty usage found in stock apps; related VHAL radar props exist separately.
Instrument cluster chime volume. Not found in stock apps.
Volume compensation vs speed. Confirmed in SystemSettings: 1=off, 2=low, 3=mid, 4=high (AUDIO_VOL_VSC_MOD_REQ / eAUDIO_PROPERTY_VOLUME_SPEED).
Audio mixing control (canAudioMix). Three byte arguments; semantics not found in stock UI.
Cross/external microphone mode (eVEHICLE_PROPERTY_XFMIC_MODE). Not found in stock audio settings.
Loudness compensation mode. Separate from Music Loudness bands (27–33). Not found in stock apps.
UI key / beep volume. Confirmed: called from Multimedia (eAUDIO_PROPERTY_VOLUME_KEY). Value range not found in available sources.
Bluetooth call volume. Inferred from VHAL AUDIO_BLUETOOTH_CALL; typical channel range 0–39 (MaxVolumeList).
Navigation prompt volume. Inferred from VHAL AUDIO_NAVI_VOLUME; typical range 0–39.
TTS / voice assistant volume. Inferred from VHAL AUDIO_SPEECH_RECOGNITION; typical range 0–39.
Listener position / sound field. Inferred from VHAL AUDIO_LISTENING_POSI. Mode values not confirmed in stock apps.
Soundwave / sound styling mode. Not found in stock apps.
Surround / stereo widening. Inferred from VHAL AUDIO_STEREO_SURROUND and AUDIO_EQ_QLI_SURROUND_SET. Likely 0/1.
Cabin acoustic preset. Not found in stock apps.
Bass boost at low volume. Inferred from VHAL AUDIO_LOUD. Likely 0=off, 1=on.
Reset audio settings command. Likely write-only (e.g. 1). Not found in stock apps.
120 Hz band boost (Music Loudness). Confirmed in firmware: T_0901_IHU_6_SET_MusicLoudness_120HZ, factory default 15.
6000 Hz band boost. Factory default 3 (unlike other bands, firmware).
Restore factory audio settings (factory command). Not found in stock apps.
Emergency / B-call volume. Inferred from MBAudioSource.eAUDIO_SOURCE_BCALL (4). Range not confirmed.
Headrest speaker routing/mode. Not found in stock apps.
